title: James B Probable NDE 9724
content: After a day of passing blood, I went to the hospital emergency department. While in the waiting area, I began to feel faint. So, I went to the reception desk. There, I passed out. I awoke on a gurney while being wheeled into a room. I had been unconscious for less than 2 minutes. During the time I was unconscious, I awoke to see everything was bathed in a light. I can't quite describe this. I was fully aware of my surroundings and my situation. I was as happy as I have ever been. I had no fear or anxiety whatsoever. I seemed to be finishing a telepathic conversation with someone who I was sure loved me totally, and whom I loved. It was suggested to me later, that this might have been my daughter who was murdered less than 2 months before. This seems possible to me, but that is not what I was thinking at the time of my experience. I remember saying that I would love to die right now, but my wife and son are both dependent on me for care and would suffer if I died now. The other person assured me that this was not my time and I would return to caring for them for a long time. I felt like this was the end of a much longer conversation but I couldn't remember what else we talked about. The light persisted for a minute or two, but the profound happiness lasted for an hour or more. The experience was vivid and seemed very real. From that time, I have been convinced that my personality will survive bodily death. Before that I believed that consciousness would persist but not my individual personality. I no longer have any reservations about death and actually look forward to it. I was not near-death since my blood pressure and oxygen level were very low but never critical. I did pass out, but calling it near-death would be an exaggeration. I could have died if the bleeding had persisted but it resolved by itself. I was admitted to the ICU and given intravenous fluid under pressure and drugs to bring up my blood pressure from the loss of blood. But as far as I know, I was never actually close to death. I saw no tunnel, no visual contact with any entity, no life review, no memory of a heavenly realm and no OBE. But my experience has some of the elements of an NDE. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 11/26/22 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I was experiencing a serious intestinal hemorrhage and lost consciousness in the emergency waiting room. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I was awake and saw and heard my surroundings in a normal way except for the light. How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I was aware of and in communication with a non-physical person. Everything was bathed in an unusual light. I was incredibly happy and completely free of any fear or anxiety. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was fully awake for the entire time that I remember. I have no memories from the period of unconsciousness. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I was looking at my physical surroundings, and I could see them but here was this light in everything. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. no difference. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I saw my physical surroundings but bathed in a light. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Profound Happiness. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I was worried about how my disabled wife and son would get by without me, and I was assured that I was not about to die and would retuen to take care of them. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Buddhist. I was a secular Buddhist with no particular expectations of afterlife. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Buddhist same as above but with a different belief about the afterlife. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Prior to the experience I did not believe that personalities survived death or were aware of living people. Now I know that both things are true. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes My beliefs about the afterlife changed. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I was in telepathic communication with someone who I know loved me and whom I loved. They were telling me that it wasn't my time to die and I would be able to take care of my wife and son. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes I had a non-specific awareness that I had existed before and would continue to exist after this life. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I felt like I was at the end of a conversation with someone on the other side about whether I was about to die. I wanted to die and 'cross over' but I was worried about my wife and son. The existence of continued consciousness after death was just assumed as a certainty, Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes Only that there were people who loved me on the other side, but love seems like a weak word for it. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life I look forward to my own death, though I have no desire to shorten my life. I now know that my daughter who was murdered a few weeks before is happy. My wife has felt her presence from time to time and I am now certain she is right. I have less anxiety in general. I have more compassion. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I have less frustration about caring for family members and no more FOMO. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I cannot describe either the euphoric Happiness or the light I cannot fully express the sense of being loved and cared for by the entity. These things don't really have any equivalent in my experience. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. The memory of the experience is vivid but I also remember all of the other events pretty well. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The sense of love and the sense that there are entities on the other side who care about me. Also, that death of loved ones is not a tragedy. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes about a year. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I have read books on the topic. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real There is just a certainty about it. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. It seems just as real as any other memory. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: Telepathic communication with a non-physical person/entity who "loved me totally" and said it was "not my time" and he would return to care for his wife and son.

environment.environment_other_detail: He reported seeing his physical surroundings "bathed in a light" and did not enter an unearthly world.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Serious intestinal hemorrhage with very low blood pressure/oxygen (reported as low but not critical) and brief loss of consciousness in the emergency department waiting room.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He reported no tunnel, no unearthly realm, no beings seen, and no life review; instead he described being in his physical surroundings bathed in light with telepathic communication and a decision/assurance to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred while unconscious for less than 2 minutes in the hospital waiting area; he reports seeing ordinary physical surroundings "bathed in a light" and a telepathic conversation with an unseen, non-physical person/entity; he emphasizes he was not clinically near death.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “everything was bathed in a light”; “I was as happy as I have ever been”; “I would love to die right now, but my wife and son are both dependent on me”; “this was not my time”; “I no longer have any reservations about death and actually look forward to it.”
